title: Light Fingers
description: Horace counts his coin every night. His real ledger - what he pays his apprentices, what he owes the tax collector - comes to me, clean, and off him. Then I will vouch for you.

objectives.description: Take Horace's real ledger without him noticing
Bring the ledger back to Raven

notes: First quest in Thieves Guild chain. Tests basic theft skills. Merchant shop should be in Dalhurst market district. Threat: small - Horace loses his real accounts and will notice. Giver motive: Raven vets recruits with a real theft before trusting them with anything that matters (matches her own dialogue). Consequence: unwired - Horace has no reaction data, and nothing tracks whether he suspects the Guild afterward.
